sentences.cn_text: 詹妮弗·西尼尔那篇见解深刻、发人深省的杂志封面文章「我爱我的孩子，我恨我的生活」引发了广泛讨论，这并不令人意外——没有什么比暗示养育子女并非完全令人满足、丰富人生的经历更能引起热议了。
sentences.en_text: It’s no surprise that Jennifer Senior’s insightful, provocative magazine cover story, “I Love My Children, I Hate My Life,” is arousing much chatter — nothing gets people talking like the suggestion that child rearing is anything less than a completely fulfilling, lifeenriching experience.

sentences.cn_text: 西尼尔并未简单断言孩子让父母幸福或痛苦，而是建议我们重新定义幸福：不应将其视为可通过瞬间的欢愉来衡量的东西，而应把幸福理解为一种过去时态的状态。
sentences.en_text: Rather than concluding that children make parents either happy or miserable, Senior suggests we need to redefine happiness: instead of thinking of it as something that can be measured by moment-to-moment joy, we should consider being happy as a past-tense condition.

sentences.cn_text: 尽管日复一日养育孩子的经历可能令人身心俱疲，西尼尔写道：「那些在当下令我们情绪低落的事情，日后可能成为强烈满足感和喜悦的源泉。」
sentences.en_text: Even though the day-to-day experience of raising kids can be soulcrushingly hard, Senior writes that “the very things that in the moment dampen our moods can later be sources of intense gratification and delight.”

sentences.cn_text: 本周报刊亭上，展示迷人母亲怀抱可爱婴儿的杂志封面，绝非唯一的圣母与圣婴形象。
sentences.en_text: The magazine cover showing an attractive mother holding a cute baby is hardly the only Madonna-and-child image on newsstands this week.

sentences.cn_text: 还有关于刚收养孩子且新近单身的妈妈桑德拉·布洛克的报道，以及惯常出现的「詹妮弗·安妮斯顿怀孕了」之类的新闻。
sentences.en_text: There are also stories about newly adoptive — and newly single — mom Sandra Bullock, as well as the usual “Jennifer Aniston is pregnant” news.

sentences.cn_text: 几乎每周都至少有一位名人母亲或准母亲面带微笑地出现在报刊亭上。
sentences.en_text: Practically every week features at least one celebrity mom, or mom-to-be, smiling on the newsstands.

sentences.cn_text: 在一个如此执着地歌颂生育的社会里，承认后悔生孩子难道不等同于承认支持虐杀小猫吗？
sentences.en_text: In a society that so persistently celebrates procreation, is it any wonder that admitting you regret having children is equivalent to admitting you support kitten-killing?

sentences.cn_text: 因此，将为人父母者的后悔与无子女者的后悔相比较，似乎并不公平。
sentences.en_text: It doesn’t seem quite fair, then, to compare the regrets of parents to the regrets of the childless.

sentences.cn_text: 不幸福的父母很少会被促使去思考自己是否不该生孩子，但不幸福的无子女者却不断被这样一种信息困扰：孩子是世界上最重要的东西，显然他们的痛苦必定是生活中缺少一个婴儿大小的空洞直接导致的。
sentences.en_text: Unhappy parents rarely are provoked to wonder if they shouldn’t have had kids, but unhappy childless folks are bothered with the message that children are the single most important thing in the world: obviously their misery must be a direct result of the gaping baby-size holes in their lives.

sentences.cn_text: 当然，像「Us Weekly」和「People」这类名人杂志所呈现的育儿形象极不真实，尤其当这些父母是像布洛克那样的单身母亲时。
sentences.en_text: Of course, the image of parenthood that celebrity magazines like Us Weekly and People present is hugely unrealistic, especially when the parents are single mothers like Bullock.

sentences.cn_text: 多项研究表明，有孩子的父母幸福感低于无子女夫妇，而单亲父母是所有群体中最不幸福的。
sentences.en_text: According to several studies concluding that parents are less happy than childless couples, single parents are the least happy of all.

sentences.cn_text: 考虑到没有伴侣依靠而独自抚养孩子需要付出多少辛劳，这并不令人震惊；然而听桑德拉和布兰妮的说法，她们「独自」（实为：在全天候帮助下）抚养孩子却轻而易举。
sentences.en_text: No shock there, considering how much work it is to raise a kid without a partner to lean on; yet to hear Sandra and Britney tell it, raising a kid on their “own” (read: with round-the-clock help) is a piece of cake.

sentences.cn_text: 很难想象会有那么多人愚蠢到仅仅因为瑞茜和安吉丽娜让育儿看起来如此光鲜就想要孩子：大多数成年人都明白，婴儿不是发型。
sentences.en_text: It’s hard to imagine that many people are dumb enough to want children just because Reese and Angelina make it look so glamorous: most adults understand that a baby is not a haircut.

sentences.cn_text: 但值得思考的是，我们每周看到的那些无压力、增添幸福感的育儿形象，是否在某种微小的潜意识层面上加剧了我们对实际育儿体验的不满，就像我们内心曾有一小部分希望剪个「瑞秋头」能让自己看起来稍微像詹妮弗·安妮斯顿一样。
sentences.en_text: But it’s interesting to wonder if the images we see every week of stress-free, happiness-enhancing parenthood aren’t in some small, subconscious way contributing to our own dissatisfactions with the actual experience, in the same way that a small part of us hoped getting “the Rachel” might make us look just a little bit like Jennifer Aniston.
